Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer initially misinterpreted the task and failed to extract the place of death from the visible results on the DuckDuckGo search page during its first query ("André Hunebelle place of death"). The viewport text contained the necessary information ("Nice, Alpes-Maritimes, France"), but WebSurfer overlooked it and did not extract or report this data. This oversight delayed the task and required additional searches for the same information, leading to inefficiency.
